pull_request.body:
## Purpose

Close the final freeze-audit gap where a genuine schema-2
`verified_workspace_artifact_v1` checkpoint could resume and perform a **new**
filesystem mutation through the historical structural `record_attempt()` path.

Stacked on #173 exact head `42c56b208e98e49fd1fc496c3b3e56f2aa13c545`.

## Finding

The #168 grant-binding research intentionally preserved schema-2 checkpoints with
the historical shared `stage26-3a-qualification` grant ref. That was truthful
for old recovery evidence, but it left future `final_create` /
`staging_cleanup` delivery outside the Core-v1 exact grant contract.

That is incompatible with Core-v1 freeze.

## Selected fix

Fresh Stage Research in
`WORKSPACE_LEGACY_GRANT_HANDOFF_REENTRY.md` returns **NARROW**.

A schema-2 checkpoint now:

1. validates and reconciles any already-prepared historical attempt first;
2. proves the current resumable filesystem state from fresh evidence;
3. requires no unresolved mutation;
4. forward-migrates only the **active** grant set to the deterministic concrete
   workspace grant;
5. records explicit handoff evidence and advances WorkingState revision;
6. durably checkpoints schema 3;
7. performs every later physical mutation only through
   `evaluate_authorized() / record_authorized_attempt()`.

Historical attempts/reconciliations are not rewritten or retroactively claimed
to have used the new grant.

## Core refinement

Adds one bounded WorkingState operation:

`replace_capability_grants(grant_refs, evidence_ref, expected_revision)`

It changes active authority only, requires an exact revision, refuses to run with
unresolved mutation state, preserves attempts/failures/reconciliations/budgets,
and appends explicit evidence.

No registry, policy service, grant database, retry engine or public tool is
introduced.

## Failure-class guard

- `_workspace_guard_decision()` no longer has a legacy mutation branch.
- `_record_workspace_attempt()` records new effects only via
  `record_authorized_attempt()`.
- Legacy `record_attempt()` is restricted to bookkeeping for an
  **already-prepared schema-2 attempt** during reconciliation before forward
  handoff.
- Integration tests prove schema-2 `staged_verified` and `final_verified`
  checkpoints are durably schema 3 with concrete grant **before** the next
  physical effect.

## Acceptance

Added/updated tests cover:

- WorkingState grant replacement revision/evidence contract;
- unresolved mutation blocking grant replacement;
- legacy state blocked from new mutation before handoff;
- forward handoff preserving historical attempts/budgets;
- schema-2 -> schema-3 before final hard-link;
- schema-2 -> schema-3 before staging cleanup.

Existing workspace crash/reconciliation, Core authorization, six-tool semantic,
installed-layout and security gates remain required.

This PR must remain Draft and must not merge before #173 and its prerequisite
stack are accepted/refreshed.

## Core-v1 freeze audit

A repository-wide consequence-surface audit was rerun after the legacy workspace finding.

| Public / registered surface | Mutation authority before delivery | Success authority | Freeze disposition |
|---|---|---|---|
| `workspace_read` | read-only | observation only | CLEAN |
| `workspace_write` | activation-bound exact `CapabilityGrant / AuthorizationRequest` | fresh exact-byte verification; provider ACK separated | CLEAN |
| `web_open` | activation + policy + before-fingerprint + exact URL/network resource authorization | fresh navigation verification; ACK separated | CLEAN |
| `web_observe` | read-only | observation only | CLEAN |
| `web_interact` | activation + policy + before-fingerprint + exact action/resource/expected-effect authorization | fresh expected-effect verification; ACK separated | CLEAN |
| `verified_workspace_artifact_v1` | WorkingState + `evaluate_authorized()`; schema-2 must forward-handoff before any new effect | Verification Kernel + reconciliation + Finish Gate | FIXED HERE |
| `windows_case_update_v1` | exact task/run/head/case/note/status grant + `evaluate_authorized()` | fresh persistent-stream Windows verification; external L3 Finish Gate remains separate | CLEAN via #173 |
| independent-review launch | fixed registered procedure only; production launch currently stops before browser dispatch | always abstains while reviewer authority is unqualified | CLEAN / separate #159 migration |
| independent-review submit/reconcile | private run capability or exact review identity/manual result contract | specialist durable review-result validation only; not task DONE | CLEAN |

The only remaining `WorkingState.record_attempt()` consumer outside the Core method itself is
the explicitly named `_record_legacy_recovery_attempt()`. It is reachable only while
describing/reconciling an **already-prepared historical schema-2 effect**. The normal
workspace mutation guard and record helpers refuse a historical admission and require the
concrete Core grant.

Visual Browser fallback was also inspected: semantic resolution performs at most one
`browser_click`; coordinate fallback consumes its prepared token before delivery and
performs one left `browser_mouse_click_xy`. Neither fallback owns final success; the
outer `web_interact` path still performs the fresh Verification Kernel check.

### Freeze invariant guard

`tests/test_cap_core_freeze_surface.py` now structurally prevents regression of the
audited ownership boundary:

- no legacy workspace guard/record path for a new effect;
- Windows case uses only authorized Core attempt paths;
- direct workspace/browser provider calls remain ordered after authorization and before
  fresh verification;
- provider seam cannot own Core authorization/state/reconciliation/completion semantics;
- the Core manifest records the new-effect authorization invariant.

The Core manifest intentionally remains `freeze-candidate`, not `frozen`, until this
stack is accepted in sequence and its release-critical exact-head review/physical gates
are satisfied.
